raw DQN/PPO/SAC/TD3 evaluation for three final seeds
reason: Pre-admission business audit found that delivery percentage used the policy-selected demand-response commitment as its denominator. A policy could reduce commitment and still report full delivery without covering the external event target.
remediation: Add a demand-response commitment gate relative to the full MPC/external-event target, require at least 98 percent commitment and at least 98 percent delivery, preserve all other gates, parallelize independent seed-window evaluations, and rerun from the beginning.
